thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — ran a BYO key handback simulation this morning and hit a weird gap. Operator completed the handback, the key disappeared from the keystore, but the KMS proxy didn't emit the related audit events. Repro x2.
chris: Ugh. Do we have logs/timestamps? which proxy version?
maria: Proxy v2.7.1 in staging. Timeline: operator ack at 10:12:03, keystore delete at 10:12:04, but proxy audit stream shows nothing between 10:11:50-10:12:20.
lee: Can you paste the proxy stdout/errors? Also, was there any 503s upstream?
maria: pasted log snippet: ```
[2025-11-04T10:12:03Z] operator: handback accepted tenant=t-42 operator_id=op-17
[2025-11-04T10:12:04Z] keystore: delete key_id=k-9b2 status=ok
# NO proxy audit event for keystore.delete for k-9b2
[2025-11-04T10:12:05Z] proxy: reconnecting to audit-stream, err=EOF
```
sam: That reconnect line worries me — sounds like audit streaming client dropped mid-transaction. Could be backpressure + retry swallowing events.
jess: Is this covered by our incident playbook? If events can be lost during handback that's an audit and compliance hole for customers.
maria: Not currently. Playbook assumes write-ahead audit is durable. This sim shows a race where backend ack occurs before audit persistence.
lee: Steps: (1) triage if this is proxy-only or also in prod paths, (2) add a blocking sync before final ACK or ensure audit writes are transactional, (3) add alerting on missing audit sequence numbers for a tenant.
chris: For triage — can we re-run sim with audit-verbose (+DEBUG) and collect wiretrace of audit client? I can schedule a brief window on staging. @lee can you add debug flag to the proxy?
lee: Yes, I'll flip verbose and add a small middleware that asserts audit sequence monotonicity and errors if gap detected. Will also attach proxy metrics for audit-latency.
sam: We should also check RBAC surfaces: if operator handback can race, are we also missing entitlements checks in the retry path? E.g., a retry could use cached creds and bypass fresh RBAC evaluation.
maria: Good call — saw one case where the handback worker retried with cached token. I think token refresh wasn't wired into the retry client.
jess: Compliance ask: we need a post-sim report for legal & customers with affected SLA window and mitigation plan. Also identify whether any external auditors need notification before we ship a fix.
chris: Vulnerability triage: assign severity. Loss of audit events for key deletion = High (potentially PII/FOI for regulated customers). Assign to oncall+sec for immediate mitigation.
maria: I'll own the mitigation: short-term patch = make proxy persist audit events to local spool before returning success to the keystore; long-term = ensure transactional integrity across keystore + audit-stream (two-phase commit or durable queue).
lee: Implementation note: local spool needs encryption-at-rest (obviously) and TTL purge. We should reuse existing spool implementation used by the metrics pipeline (kafka fallback).
sam: KMS integration question: does the customer-managed KMS (BYOK) path use the same proxy codepath? If yes, this affects many customers.
maria: Yes — BYOK path funnels through the proxy. I've flagged t-42 as a test tenant; we should run cross-tenant tests.
chris: Oncall runbook updates: add an urgent step — if audit-stream reconnects (EOF/connection reset) during a key lifecycle op, triage as potential audit-loss incident and flip to degraded mode: block final ACK until audit confirmed.
jess: Product note: update the KB and support templates to communicate the temporary degraded mode and the expected customer notification cadence.
lee: I'll open a small RFC with implementation plan and include benchmarks for added latency. We need to quantify impact of blocking sync on 95th p99.
maria: Also adding a metric: "audit_gap_detected{tenant}" + alert when count>0 in 5m. Patch ETA: 48h for spool patch in staging, 1 week for transactional rework.
sam: For vulnerability tracker: create GH issue and mark as CVE? Probably not externally visible vulnerability, but tag as security-bug and link to incident response ticket.
maria: Created issue infra/eng#8792 and linked simulation logs.
chris: Who's notifying compliance/legal? @jess or @maria?
jess: I'll notify legal and prepare a one-pager for customers. cc: audit-bot will log the internal notification.
audit-bot: [automated] Notification recorded: incident-candidate=YES priority=high owner=maria ticket=infra/eng#8792
maria: Thanks. Next steps summary: lee implements verbose checks + spool, chris schedules staging rerun, sam audits RBAC retry path, jess handles comms/legal. We'll reconvene after staging run.
lee: I'll post the RFC link here when ready.
maria: Thanks everyone. If you see any anomalies in production telemetry for audit_stream_errors, page me. :rotating_light:
